what_each_new_part_touches: Sub-steps 1-8 (5-8 are on page 167) and a yellow box: red axles go into an orange angled connector (1), a second orange angled connector is added (2), a dark grey ball part is added (3), and two orange smooth connectors with red axles are pushed on the two open ends (4, 2x box).
where_everything_is_after: an orange two-arm fitting with a grey ball, red axles, black ovals and a blue pin is ready to be placed on the rear of the frame

why.problem_solved: Builds the orange hose-end fitting used as the engine breather on the model.
why.why_these_parts: Angled connectors and axle connectors make a rigid pipe shape.
why.sets_up_for_later: The next pages show where it goes.

review_note: The part list at the top shows 1x ball part, 5x red axles, 2x blue pins, 2x orange angled connectors, 4x orange axle connectors and 2x thin black ovals. Sub-steps 5-8 are on page 167: a red axle goes in the first orange arm and a black thin oval is slid on it (7), then a blue pin goes through the oval into the second arm (8). The finished fitting is placed on the frame's left rear on page 168 (arrow, no number).
